Awarded Institutions & Grants

Funded Universities & Award Recipients

Peer-reviewed capacity building grants, compute allocations for computational tools, and graduation project research funding awarded to international partner universities.

🎓 2026 Graduation Grant
Egypt

Al-Azhar University (Assiut Branch)

Empowering talented undergraduate researchers across Upper Egypt with bio-computational training and enhanced wet-lab chemical support over the 3-year cycle.

PI: Prof. Ahmed Salem M. Solieman View Award
🎓 2026 Graduation Grant
Egypt

Cairo University

Empowering 20 Graduation Project Teams per year (200 undergraduate students annually, 600 young scientists over 3 years) with computational suites and direct experimental chemical support.

PI: Dr. Nourhan Hassan (Assistant Professor, Biotechnology Department) View Award
🎓 2026 Graduation Grant
Egypt

Helwan University

Empowering undergraduate researchers across Biotechnology, Biochemistry, and Biological Sciences with computational pipelines and practical chemical consumables.

PI: Designated Faculty of Science Main PI / Institutional Representative View Award
🎓 2026 Graduation Grant
Egypt

Pharos University in Alexandria

Empowering pharmacy graduates with Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD), molecular docking simulations, and wet-lab pharmacological assay support.

PI: Assoc. Prof. Nesrine Saeid El-Mezayen View Award
🎓 2026 Graduation Grant
Russian Federation

Center for the Development of Scientific & Educational Connection

Advancing computational engineering, cross-border biological modeling, big data analytics, and laboratory materials for researchers.

PI: Nawras T. Jassim (Main PI & Representative) View Award
🎓 2026 Graduation Grant
Saudi Arabia

Sulaiman Al-Rajhi University

Fostering medical research, clinical pharmacology analytics, and bio-modeling with wet-lab experimental consumables across the Qassim region.

PI: Dr. Eman Ibrahim Anwar M. Ahmed (Assistant Professor in Clinical Pharmacology) View Award

Welcome to UKABCS

Research, education and collaboration with a clear purpose.

UKABCS connects researchers, universities, institutions and industry partners around meaningful scientific progress.

We support rigorous, open and inclusive science through funding opportunities, education, publishing, events and international collaboration.

Discover UKABCS
Membership

Why become a UKABCS Member?

Earn. Connect. Advance. Lead.

UKABCS Membership connects researchers, academics, students, professionals, innovators, institutions and industry stakeholders. It creates meaningful opportunities to strengthen professional connections, access specialised resources, engage with experts and explore collaboration and career development across disciplines and geographical boundaries.

Explore membership
Our Mission

Rigorous, open and inclusive science for real-world challenges.

We support rigorous, open and inclusive science that addresses real-world challenges, strengthens collaboration across borders and accelerates innovation in biotechnology and computational research.

About our work
Our Vision

A global research ecosystem where every scientist can contribute.

Our vision is a global research ecosystem where every scientist, regardless of background or geography, has the opportunity to contribute, collaborate and innovate for the benefit of humanity.

Explore UKABCS
Our work

What We Do

Practical support for a connected, responsible and inclusive scientific community.

01

Funding & grants

Support for research projects and capacity-building initiatives in biotechnology and computational science.

02

Education & training

Learning opportunities, resources and practical support for emerging researchers.

03

Support for sharing knowledge through open science, publications and scientific events.

04

Collaboration across academia, industry and society to turn ideas into impact.

05

Inclusive opportunities that strengthen participation in the global research community.

Research support

Have a research need that does not fit a current call?

UKABCS is here to help researchers find the right route for promising work and meaningful scientific progress.

How UKABCS can help

  • OpportunitiesIdentify relevant programmes, calls and collaboration routes.
  • Research guidanceDirect researchers toward suitable resources and next steps.
  • Innovation pathwaysHelp connect research ideas with support that may be available.

UKABCS

UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science (UKABCS) is a UK-registered non-profit academic society dedicated to peer-reviewed research, transparent grant funding, and open-access scientific education.
